items.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed

items.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google's new Willow breakthrough
items.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.
